description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the PerformanceTracker entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set related employee data, and retrieve formatted date information for performance tracking records.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for managing and augmenting PerformanceTracker entities, including setting related employee references and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the decorator with a PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the performance tracker based on employee number.

methods.name: setAddedByByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee who added the performance tracker, based on employee number.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the added date of the performance tracker, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the modified date of the performance tracker, formatted as a string.
